description:
Return the standard dosha (planetary affliction) checks for the chart. The result maps each dosha name to the engine's text on whether the combination is present in this horoscope and the reasoning behind it. Doshas covered: Kala Sarpa Dosha, Manglik Dosha, Pitru Dosha, Guru Chandala Dosha, Ganda Moola Dosha, Kalathra Dosha, Ghata Dosha and Shrapit Dosha. The text may contain light HTML markup (e.g.
). It is the engine's classical reference text for astrologer interpretation; some entries quote traditional outcome statements (for example about marriage or longevity) -- present those as classical sayings, not as predictions about this person.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST
